scope: Shared FullHDGlass configuration-list font compatibility and native installer display, independent of image version.
owner_screenshot_context: Owner clarified the supplied font/installer screenshots were taken on OpenATV 8.0.2; the problems are not restricted to the 8.1 beta.
font_root_cause: Plugin fallback layouts use 25 pixel rows without local font attributes, inheriting FullHDGlass window-style fonts Prive3 33/30.
font_repair: Scoped, idempotent ConfigList.applySkin adapter fits fonts to the final native row height, respects suitable explicit fonts, restores fonts on taller re-skins, and delegates other skins unchanged. No configuration values or plugin files are changed.
installer_root_cause: The earlier Opkg geometry repair preserved source/render binding for native GUI Labels status/package. They display an initial snapshot and fail to track native event updates and visibility.
installer_repair: Use the existing native status/package components by name; draw full-width native progress bars and fit both installation-selection lists inside their windows.
